rankingPrep: Amanota, urutonde n'amanota bizaboneka igihe seriveri yo kuri interineti izaba imaze guhuzwa. Ntibiraboneka.
spectatePrep: Amanota azaboneka igihe seriveri yo kuri interineti izaba imaze guhuzwa. Ntibiraboneka.
contactPrep: Aho umuntu agana ntabwo ari heza. Iyo imaze guhuzwa, uzabasha kohereza uhereye hano. Ibyinjizwa n'akabuto ko kohereza birafunze ubu.
myInqPrep: Iyo aho umuntu agana hamaze guhuzwa, uzabasha kubona ubutumwa bwawe bwoherejwe n'ibisubizo hano.
r1c: Kanda ahantu hari ubusa kugira ngo ushyire igice. Umukara n'umweru birasimburana gushyiramo kugeza ibice byose bigeze ku kibaho. Umukara ubanza kwimuka.
r1c2: Uko ukina: kanda gusa ahantu hari ubusa aho umwambi w'umweru werekeza.
r2t: ② Shyira umurongo wa gatatu: urusyo
r2c: Iyo ibice bitatu byawe bihagaze ku murongo, ni urusyo, kandi ushobora gufata kimwe mu bice by'uwo muhanganye.
r2c2: Uko ukina: nyuma yo gukora urusyo, kanda ku gice cy'uwo muhanganye ushaka gufata.
r2c3: Igice kiri mu rusyo ntigishobora gufatwa, keretse ibice byose by'uwo muhanganye biri mu rusyo; noneho ushobora gufata kimwe mu rusyo.
r3c: Iyo ibice byose bimaze gushyirwaho, shyira igice ku murongo ugana ahantu hadafite ikintu hafi aho. Ibice bishobora kugenda bituma impeta y'ibara igaragara inyuma. Kanda ku gice maze aho kijya haka.
r3c2: Uko wakina: kanda ku gice ushaka kwimura, hanyuma ukande ahantu hafite urumuri hafi aho.
r4t: ④ Kugeza kuri bitatu? Urashobora kuguruka
r4c: Iyo usigaranye ibice bitatu gusa, ushobora kuguruka ugana ahantu hadafite ikintu, nubwo nta murongo ubihuza.
r4c2: Uko wakina: kanda ku gice cyawe, hanyuma ukande ahantu hadafite ikintu ushaka kuguruka.
r5c: Utsinda ugabanya uwo muhanganye ibice bibiri, cyangwa ukamusiga nta kintu cyemewe n'amategeko.
r6c: Buri mukinnyi afite ibice 12 kandi hongeweho imirongo ine y'umurongo ugororotse. Ushobora kugenda ugororotse, kandi itatu mu murongo ku murongo ugororotse nayo ikora urusyo.
r6c2: Uko wakina: ingendo z'umurongo ugororotse zikora kimwe — kanda ku gice, hanyuma aho ugana.
r6c3: Niba ikibaho cyuzuye neza mu gihe cyo gushyiramo, umukinnyi ugomba kwimuka ntashobora kugenda agatsindwa.
r7c: Umukino ukorwa mu buryo bwikora muri buri rubanza ruri hepfo. Nta buto bwo gutanga tombola.
r7c2: · Ahantu hamwe n'umukinnyi umwe ugomba kwimuka habaho inshuro eshatu
r7c3: · Ingendo 50 (abakinnyi bombi bahujwe) batera nta mashini ikora
r7c4: · Verisiyo y'ibice 12 gusa: mu gihe umukinnyi afite ibice bitatu, ingendo 10 (zihujwe) nta muntu ufata
r8c: Nubwo imashini imwe yakora imashini ebyiri icyarimwe, uracyafata igice kimwe gusa.
r8c2: Verisiyo y'ibice 9: ushobora kumena imashini ukongera ukayifunga mu ngendo yawe ikurikira; igihe cyose uyifunze, ufata igice.
r8c3: Verisiyo y'ibice 12: imashini wavunitse ntishobora kongera gukorwa mu ngendo yawe ikurikira; tegereza intambwe imwe. Ingendo zidakora imashini zikora ni nziza.
r8c4: Imikino yo kuri interineti ifite intambwe eshatu: Ibisanzwe ni amasegonda 30 kuri buri ngendo, Buhoro ni iminota 2, kandi Inyuguti ni amasaha 24. Mu mikino ya Slow and Letter, kwimuka gukinwa mu buryo bwikora iyo igihe kirangiye.

tutDone: Noneho uzi uburyo bwo gushyira, gukora urusyo, gufata, kwimura, kuguruka no gutsinda. Gerageza mu mukino nyawo.
titlesPrep: Imitwe izagaragara seriveri yo kuri interineti imaze guhuzwa. Amazina n'amabwiriza y'imitwe winjiza azerekana neza uko seriveri izisubiza. Ntiziteguye.
myTurnsPrep: Imikino y'inyuguti aho ari igihe cyawe kizagaragara hano seriveri imaze guhuzwa. Ntiziteguye.
slowNote: Imikino igenda buhoro ni imikino igaragara ifite iminota 2 kuri buri gikorwa. Iyo igihe kirangiye, igikorwa gikinwa mu buryo bwikora.
letterNote: Mu mukino w'inyuguti ufite amasaha 24 kuri buri gikorwa. Iyo igihe kirangiye, igikorwa gikinwa mu buryo bwikora.
